title: dactylorhiza fuchsii var. psychrophila
intro: Dactylorhiza fuchsii var. psychrophila, commonly known as the alpine marsh orchid, is a rare and unique variety of the fuchs orchid species. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and protect the skin and mucous membranes. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza fuchsii var. psychrophila include calming and relaxing effects, as well as a potential anti-edematous action, which may be beneficial in reducing swelling and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
